def S2C_8dim(vec):
    """
    Function to convert spherical 8-length numpy array coordinates to cartesian

    Parameters
    ----------
    vec : ~numpy.array
        Array of shape (n,8) in the form [t,r,theta,phi,vt,vr,vtheta,vphi] in SI units.

    Returns
    -------
    ~numpy.array
        Array of shape (n,8) in the form [t,x,y,z,vt,vx,vy,vz] in SI units

    """
    newvec = np.copy(vec)
    newvec[:, 1:4] = np.vectorize(SphericalToCartesian_pos, signature='(n)->(m)')(vec[:, 1:4])
    newvec[:, 5:8] = np.vectorize(SphericalToCartesian_vel, signature='(n),(m)->(p)')(vec[:, 1:4], vec[:, 5:8])
    return newvec
